plugins.name: snapvisor
plugins.description: Review visual regression builds from Claude with SnapVisor: see what changed in screenshot diffs, approve or reject builds with confirmation, handle flaky changes, join review threads, and report usage.

skills.name: discussing-builds
skills.description: Reads and joins the comment threads on a SnapVisor build, test, or media item: summarizes the discussion, replies, reacts, resolves or reopens threads, and follows builds, each change after confirmation. Use when the user asks to 'summarize the comments on build 42', 'show open review threads', 'reply to the open thread and resolve it', 'post a comment on this diff', 'reopen that thread', or 'follow this build'.
skills.description_zh: 阅读 SnapVisor 构建、测试或媒体评论，汇总讨论、回复、回应、解决重开线程及关注构建；每次变更均需确认。

skills.name: handling-flaky-changes
skills.description: Handles flaky or known visual changes in SnapVisor: ignores or un-ignores a change after confirmation, finds flaky tests, and lists the ignored changes for a project. Use when the user asks to 'ignore the date-widget change, it's the flaky clock again', 'which tests are flaky', 'stop flagging this change', 'un-ignore this change', 'show ignored changes', or deal with noisy screenshot diffs.
headings: Flaky and ignored changes in SnapVisor
skills.description_zh: 处理 SnapVisor 不稳定或已知视觉变化，经确认忽略或取消忽略，查找不稳定测试并列出项目已忽略项。

skills.name: reporting-snapvisor-usage
skills.description: Reports SnapVisor account activity and access: builds and screenshots per period, busiest projects, daily, weekly, or monthly trends, members, and pending invites. Use when the user asks 'how many builds did we run this month', 'how many screenshots did we use', 'which projects are busiest', 'show usage trends', 'who is on the team', or 'which invites are pending'. Read-only.
skills.description_zh: 只读报告 SnapVisor 账号活动及访问情况，按周期汇总构建截图、繁忙项目、日周月趋势、成员和待处理邀请。

skills.name: reviewing-visual-builds
skills.description: Reviews a SnapVisor visual regression build: shows what changed in the screenshot diffs for a branch or commit and approves or rejects the build after the user confirms. Use when the user asks 'what changed in the latest build', 'show the screenshot diffs', 'review the visual changes on this branch', 'approve build 42, the nav restyle is intentional', 'reject this build', or asks about visual testing or UI regression results.
skills.description_zh: 审查 SnapVisor 分支或提交的截图差异，解释视觉变化，并在用户确认后批准或拒绝构建。

skills.name: setup-snapvisor
skills.description: Connects the SnapVisor MCP server to Claude and verifies it with one read-only call: where to connect in claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cowork, or Claude Code, what the SnapVisor sign-in and consent screen asks, and how to recover when a tool is missing. Use when the user asks to 'set up SnapVisor', 'connect SnapVisor to Claude', 'install the SnapVisor connector', 'sign in to SnapVisor', 'why can't Claude see my SnapVisor data', 'SnapVisor tools are missing', or reports 'Tool not found' for a SnapVisor tool.
skills.description_zh: 连接 SnapVisor MCP 到 Claude，通过一次只读调用验证，说明 claude.ai、Desktop、Cowork 和 Code 接入、登录同意及工具缺失恢复。
